from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,time,json
for p in ['/home/ubuntu/.cache','/root/.cache','/root/.gradle/caches','/tmp','/var/cache/apt/archives']:
 x=Path(p)
 if not x.is_dir():continue
 r=subprocess.run(['du','-x','-B1','--max-depth=1',p],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=50)
 print('CACHE_ROOT',p,'RC',r.returncode)
 sizes=[]
 for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
  try:s,name=line.split('\t',1);sizes.append((int(s),name))
  except ValueError:pass
 for size,name in sorted(sizes,reverse=True)[:28]:print('CACHE_DIR',p,name,size)
print('===RUNNING_INSTALLERS===')
for p in Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not p.name.isdigit():continue
 try:
  cmd=(p/'cmdline').read_bytes().replace(b'\0',b' ').decode(errors='replace')
  if 'python3 -' in cmd:continue
  if any(word in cmd for word in ('pip install','npm install','apt-get','gradle build','./gradlew','uv pip','pip cache purge')):
   print('INSTALLER_PROCESS',p.name,cmd[:200])
 except OSError:pass
print('===SERVICES===')
for name in ['fadego-staging','lowcost-europa','pink-iptv-backend','pink-vpn','nginx','postgresql@16-main','pm2-root']:
 r=subprocess.run(['systemctl','is-active',name+'.service'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=9)
 print('SERVICE',name,r.stdout.strip())
print('===DISK===')
r=subprocess.run(['df','-h','/'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
print(r.stdout.replace('\n',' | '))
print('CACHE_PREFLIGHT=PASS')
PY
